purpose: Water-only replacement integrated for full-game visual review; v1 preserved.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production water-only background bitmap for a cheerful pixel-art catgirl pool game.
Generate one 2:1 landscape image, edge-to-edge clear swimming pool water seen exactly from straight above. Only water, no characters, props, pool edge, UI, text, borders or scene. The entire rectangle will fill a large playable arena behind six cute sprites, so visual quiet is essential.
Art direction: welcoming, clean sunlit pale turquoise and cyan-blue water with subtle translucent depth. Approximately 80 percent of the area should be calm open water with soft low-contrast broad color variation. Across the remaining area, add a sparse few thin SHORT DISCONNECTED curved caustic light strokes, very soft pale aqua rather than white; each highlight ends into open water. Widely spaced, varied lengths, gently bent horizontal and diagonal segments with no crossing. NO closed outlines, NO interconnected mesh, NO cell patterns, NO honeycomb, NO web, NO scales, NO dark blue islands encircled by bright edges. Avoid deep dark patches, sharp contrast, busy texture, grids or repeated motifs. This must read as pleasant clear pool water at a glance, not a biological surface.
Style: refined handcrafted pixel-art material. Visible crisp small square pixel clusters with restrained palette and clean stepped edges, approximately 640x320 logical pixel detail displayed larger. Broad related aquamarine color fields remain extremely subtle; avoid noisy dithering. No photorealism, blur, watercolor paper, vector art, glowing veins, sparkles, star shapes, bubbles, wave rings or foam. Do not fill empty areas with additional lines. Keep the few highlight strokes delicate and the whole image visually peaceful. No horizon, no underwater floor tiles, no perspective.
